legacy.heading: Core Engineering Principles
legacy.subheading: Standard practices across our service architecture
legacy.centralTheme: Building resilient, maintainable, and observable distributed systems.

concepts.title: Domain Modeling
concepts.quote: Maintain strict separation of business logic and transport infrastructure.

concepts.title: Modular Architecture
concepts.quote: Encapsulate responsibilities cleanly to reduce coupling across services.

concepts.title: System Scalability
concepts.quote: Design stateless components capable of horizontal scaling under load.

concepts.title: Root-Cause Analysis
concepts.quote: Investigate incidents systematically to fix root issues rather than symptoms.

concepts.title: Code Quality
concepts.quote: Prioritize automated testing, linting, and continuous code reviews.

legacy.transitionText: These design patterns guide our daily development workflows.
legacy.transitionLegacy: Documented in the internal engineering engineering handbook.
